items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: And sure enough, Mr. Bill, that white boy, I gave him a card. He said, you going to yell for me, Mr. Bill? That boy got more jobs for you.

ctx.x: like to hire for Saturday night.

I said, well, I'm going to tell you the truth. I said, I'm really sorry. I said, I couldn't accept the job. I said, because I'm working. He said, well, you think you could get us a band? I told him, yeah. You know what I mean? And after I tell him that, he said, kid, I'm going to leave it up to you. And I never disappoint him. Anybody wanted a band and I couldn't work, I'd get them a band. I'd ring up, you know, got the phone, I'd ring them up. I'd say, well, listen, I got a job such and such a place. And if you…
Well, did you ever have any other day jobs in those days? Or did music keep you busy?
